name: Please Be Quiet Anchorage 2024
information:
# THIS IS A BLINDFOLDED & FMC COMPETITION. If you'd like to compete in a non-blindfodled competition, please see [The Last Frontier Summer 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TheLastFrontierSummer2024).

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietAnchorage2024#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

This competition features mostly blindfolded events. For a more traditional competition experience, see [The Last Frontier Summer 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TheLastFrontierSummer2024).
